issues.quote: Félix laughed, as he does when he is embarrassed, and said that his father's silver watch had run badly for ten years and that he would not let anyone touch it, not even his uncle.
issues.fact: O1 gives only one watch reading for Félix: his watch showed twenty minutes to nine at the nine o'clock bell. The fact sheet mentions no silver watch.
issues.misreading: The 'twenty minutes to nine' reading sits right before a second watch (the father's silver watch) that 'had run badly' and was not handed over. A solver could wonder whether the 8:40 reading belongs to the silver watch, or whether Félix showed the silver watch at all. The sentence does not say that Félix's shown watch was the silver one, but the proximity invites the question.
